description.value: Family-run lakeside resort on Horse Lake, 16 km east of 100 Mile House, with well-maintained tent sites set among pine, spruce, fir, and aspen; boat and kayak rentals on-site make it a natural hub for a water-activity layover day. Tent sites are $30/night; the commercial resort atmosphere suits families more than solitude-seekers.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and serves as the primary evidence source; OSM tags supply address and category, both corroborated by the website. The resort offers tenting sites with fire pits and picnic tables, 51 full-hookup RV sites, and 12 cabins on Horse Lake, 16 km east of 100 Mile House — an active, operated campground. No bike-specific amenities, hiker/biker designations, campground-wide showers, laundry, or cycling-focused services are mentioned anywhere on the site; 'Book Now' buttons on multiple pages confirm reservations are accepted.
concerns: OSM name is 'Bonanza Resort' but the website consistently uses 'Cariboo Bonanza Resort' — the OSM name appears to be abbreviated or outdated.
OSM record has no phone number; phone 250-395-3766 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operated campground with tenting sites in a scenic BC Cariboo location; a useful overnight stop for touring cyclists riding the Cariboo Highway (Hwy 97) corridor.

wow_evidence: family-run lakeside resort on Horse Lake...tenting sites with fire pits and picnic tables; no bike-specific amenities mentioned
